title: Playful cat copies each clap her human makes
description:
Life with a cat is never quiet and certainly never boring!

Nejira shared this hilarious moment starring her sister and their paw-some sidekick Maćkica.

While her sister was clapping along joyfully, Maćkica decided to join the fun by mimicking every move with her tiny paws.

The result was a synchronized show that could put any dance duo to shame.

Maćkica’s cheeky little performance proves that feline flair and a touch of drama come included in every cat package.
